title: Capture
description: A sealed, immutable collection act as the Hub sends it in the changes feed. Its attachments arrive as Attachment rows and its links as Relations. Open: clients ignore members they do not know.

device_id.description: The Device whose token committed the Capture; the Hub's own Device row for a local import. Never sent by the client (E16).

category_hint.description: The capturing client's guess at what this is, for the Inbox.
